step1.title: List your property as Off-Market
step1.description: Create your property profile as Off-Market. Share key information that values your property.

step2.title: Define which leads can see it
step2.description: Open your property only to top-rated profiles, based on their likelihood of securing funding from submitted financial information.

step3.title: Open it gradually to a wider audience
step3.description: If no top-tier buyer is found, simply offer your property to the next tier. Your property stays confidential and does not become stale.

step1.title: Complete buyer or renter profile
step1.description: Safely provide your funding information. It stays confidential and is never shared for commercial or other uses.

step2.title: Likelihood of obtaining funding
step2.description: Based on shared financial data, our partner calculates your likelihood of funding approval. Regardless of the rate, it shows owners you are a serious candidate.

step3.title: Reveal hidden opportunities
step3.description: Based on your funding rate, the Off-market section gives privileged access to hidden opportunities, boosting your profile credibility and increasing your chances to secure the property.

f1.title: Lead financial background check
f1.text: Each lead's financial background is checked to increase your chance of closing the transaction the first time.

f2.text: Avoid getting overwhelmed with lead solicitations by setting a lead limit.

f3.text: Open visit slots and send individual or automated invites to leads so they can book a slot.

f4.title: Share ID card to secure the visit
f4.text: Both owner and lead can share their IDs so both parties can attend visits safely.

f5.title: Visit reviews to help owners
f5.text: After a visit, leads can review it. Reviews are shared with owners to improve future visits.

f6.title: Request or share property documents
f6.text: Leads can request property documents before making an offer or applying. Owners can share them through the app.

f7.title: Buyer or renter file
f7.text: Both renters and buyers can create their file in the app so it can be shared easily with owners when applying.

f8.title: Apply or make an offer for a property
f8.text: Through the app, leads can apply or make an official offer for a property purchase.

f9.title: Answer a lead proposal
f9.text: Through the app, owners can respond to an offer or application for a property purchase.

f10.title: Chat with leads during the transaction
f10.text: Discuss through the app to speed up your transaction and move toward closing.

f11.title: Shared calendar for signing the contract
f11.text: Open signing slots and let the buyer book a suitable slot directly in your agenda.

f12.title: Transaction history
f12.text: Keep track of every stage of your transaction.

f13.title: Transfer property profile ownership
f13.text: After completing your property sale, transfer ownership of the property profile to the new owner.

f1.text: To secure your transaction, ask your AI assistant any question or doubt.

f3.title: Need support on specific actions?
